summary: Retested iteration_4 fix (search-overrides-category) on /market with hard cache-busting (?nocache=timestamp + context.clear_cookies + reload networkidle). Verified line 95 of Market.jsx on disk BEFORE browser testing: `if (!needle && cat !== "todos" && x.categoria !== cat) return false;` — matches spec exactly. All 6 scenarios pass with the updated bundle. The iteration_4 false-negative is resolved.
